## 更新内容 / Changes

- 增加 ChatGPT OAuth 与本地 API 网关的混合实例模式。绑定真实 OAuth 账号的本地 API 实例启动时继续通过管理器网关发送请求，同时把真实账号身份投影到 Codex 客户端；实例停止、取消、异常退出和重启恢复都会按加密恢复记录还原原始 `auth.json` 与配置。纯 API Key 仍不会伪造 ChatGPT 账号身份。
- 修复本地 API OAuth 实例在客户端中只显示供应商、无法识别绑定账号的问题；实例卡片会区分本地 API、待验证和已验证的客户端身份，并在启动前说明投影行为。
- 扩展跨版本兼容策略：Codex 桌面语言、Normal / Fast、Ultra 和新版界面能力按安装程序的实际结构探测并独立降级，未知版本继续使用官方界面，不再要求每次客户端升级都单独登记版本。
- 修复实例停止、管理器退出、启动取消、客户端崩溃和配置恢复之间的生命周期边界，保留运行中的客户端与本地网关，恢复记录只归属当前实例；保留旧账号库、实例路径、会话和加密数据格式。

- Added a hybrid mode for ChatGPT OAuth identity with the manager's Local API gateway. A Local API instance bound to a real OAuth account continues to route requests through the manager while projecting the real account identity into the Codex client. Stop, cancellation, launch failure and restart recovery restore the original `auth.json` and configuration from the encrypted recovery journal. Pure API keys never fabricate a ChatGPT account identity.
- Fixed Local API OAuth instances that showed only the provider name in the client. Instance cards now distinguish Local API, pending verification and verified client identity, and explain the projection before launch.
- Extended cross-version compatibility: desktop language, Normal / Fast, Ultra and newer UI capabilities are detected from the installed client's actual structure and downgraded independently. Unknown versions keep the official UI, so each client upgrade does not require a separate version entry.
- Fixed lifecycle boundaries across instance stop, manager quit, launch cancellation, client crashes and configuration recovery. Running clients and their local gateways remain owned by the background manager, with recovery records scoped to the instance; existing account vaults, instance paths, sessions and encrypted formats are preserved.

## 下载与升级 / Downloads and upgrades

提供 macOS Apple Silicon（arm64）的 DMG / ZIP，附件包含 `SHA256SUMS.txt`。关闭管理器窗口不会停止运行中的实例；实例全部结束并完成配置回收后管理器才会退出。账号、实例、会话和本地配置保留。应用内自动更新尚未接入，安装包未进行 Developer ID 签名或公证。

DMG and ZIP packages are provided for macOS Apple Silicon (arm64), with `SHA256SUMS.txt`. Closing the manager window does not stop running instances; the manager exits after all instances finish and their configuration is restored. Accounts, instances, sessions and local settings are retained. In-app automatic updates, Developer ID signing and notarization are not included.

## 客户端支持 / Client support

当前支持 Codex，客户端需单独安装。Claude Code 与 Claude Desktop（Chat / Cowork / Code）为计划功能，尚未接入。兼容能力依赖已安装 Codex 的实际结构、账号身份、套餐、模型和服务商；管理器不会把纯 API 凭据显示成 ChatGPT 登录。

Codex is currently supported and must be installed separately. Claude Code and Claude Desktop (Chat / Cowork / Code) are planned, not implemented. Compatibility depends on the installed Codex structure, account identity, plan, model and provider; the manager does not display a pure API credential as a ChatGPT login.

## 验证来源 / Verification

版本标签 `v0.5.0` 将指向完整来源提交；GitHub Actions “Build release” 会运行公开仓库检查、macOS arm64 源码测试、打包检查并生成附件校验值。安装包校验值见附件 `SHA256SUMS.txt`。

The `v0.5.0` tag will identify the complete source commit. GitHub Actions “Build release” will run the public repository check, macOS arm64 source tests, packaging checks and installer checksum generation. Installer hashes are provided in the attached `SHA256SUMS.txt`.
